prompts.prompt: For an AWS WAF WebACL that protects a CloudFront distribution, in which AWS region must the WebACL be created? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/aws-waf/SKILL.md - Scopes: CLOUDFRONT - WebACL must be created in us-east-1, associated to CloudFront distribution

prompts.prompt: What is the default maximum Web ACL Capacity Unit total for a single AWS WAFv2 WebACL? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/aws-waf/SKILL.md - WCU (Web ACL Capacity Units): WebACL default limit is 5,000 WCU

prompts.prompt: AWS WAF rate-based rule statements count requests toward the configured limit over what fixed time window? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/aws-waf/SKILL.md - Custom rate-based rule example: limit = 300 Requests per 5-minute window (100/min effective)
